facts.fact: NAM-CSIRT, the national cyber security incident response team housed at CRAN, is stated to exist and operate: it is housed under CRAN and headed by CRAN's CEO.

NAM-CSIRT's Q2 2026 newsletter reports 513,921 cyber vulnerabilities and 161,547 cyber events detected in April-June 2026, up 39.8% and 56.7% on the previous quarter. (Reported by New Era, 2026-07-23.)
After the March 2026 breach of Namibia Airports Company, NAM-CSIRT, CRAN, specialists and the company worked together to contain and investigate it.
